name: netease-mail
description: Use NetEase Mail accounts from Codex through a local IMAP/SMTP MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize, search, and draft mail for 163/126/yeah accounts.
interface.longDescription: NetEase Mail connects Codex to NetEase-backed mailboxes through a local MCP server. It starts with IMAP read workflows and guarded SMTP sending that must be explicitly enabled.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my NetEase inbox from the last week.
Find recent mail from a sender in my 163 mailbox.
Draft a reply for this NetEase email.
